r_hip.rule: among placements with surface and non-forearm limbs at worst contact (>= -3.5 cm) in play: nearest to the source grab (standing grip gap, then rotation); the forearm / hand swing is reported separately

settle.pendulum_rule: the stowed pistol may swing only while the reaching hand is within 12 cm of its grip

l_hip.rule: no placement is at worst contact; best worst clearance among those within 10 cm of the source grab
l_hip.decision: v1 keeps the rev 1 carry (thrust through the belt, lock IN, butt back: the mirror of the right-hip carry, drawn by the mirrored left-hand draw; grade C). The period carry (hooked, lock OUT, butt FORWARD for a right-hand cross draw; dz5_lhip_x280t15) turns the pistol 160-178 deg from the mirrored source grab, so it needs the Actor_A hol-- cross draw after retargeting; its fit is measured here for that upgrade.

horn.rule: a right-side place (not the rev 1 mid-back one) at worst contact in play and clear of the right-hip pistol; best worst clearance

string_ribbon_rev1.rule: ribbon length <= braced string length + 2 cm (a string does not stretch)
